added_rules.name: Inherited M03 Physical initialization

added_rules.name: Inherited M06 Saturating constitutive influence
added_rules.statement: f_k,+/-=1-exp(-m_k,+/-/m_scale); stress and conduction consume the sum of the two channels. This compresses extension/shortening distinctions at readout. m_scale=0.2 is selected, not registered.

added_rules.name: Inherited M07 Stored elastic energy
added_rules.statement: W=G0/2*(tr(FF^T)-3)+Gm/2*sum_k w_k*(f_k,+ + f_k,-)*e_k^2. G0=0.08, Gm=0.18. This is an added anisotropic constitutive law, not the corpus Newtonian stress row or a calibrated Burgers clay law.

added_rules.name: Inherited M08 Elastic stress and momentum feedback
added_rules.statement: tau=G0(FF^T-I)+sum_k Gm*w_k*(f_k,+ + f_k,-)*e_k*d_k*d_k^T. Its spread divergence enters momentum. The isotropic subtraction is an incompressible pressure convention.

added_rules.name: Inherited M09 Raw memory-writing rate

added_rules.name: Inherited M12 Anisotropic heat conduction

added_rules.name: Inherited N14 Verification criteria

All 531 executed check rows, their evidence and exact checker source are appended; the 10% material criterion failed and was not changed.

added_rules.name: Fabric rest-strain microstructure
added_rules.statement: At existing material addresses, bistable residual strains b_l enter W_l=k(e_l(F)-b_l)^2/2+H((b_l/a)^2-1)^2/4. All fixed cells exist at initialization. Stress is derived from W and enters momentum.
added_rules.reason: Define an actual constitutive effect, instead of renaming the old external archive.

added_rules.name: Fabric rearrangement and heat
added_rules.statement: b_dot=-mobility*dW/db; its nonnegative mobility*(dW/db)^2 loss becomes heat. Material addresses move with X and F. No sign reset, imposed readout floor or history refresh.
added_rules.reason: Provide coupled restructuring and an accounted energy transfer.

added_rules.name: Virtual mechanical observation
added_rules.statement: Two local axial strain probes evaluate the derivative traction k(e-b); calibrated slopes/intercepts estimate residual strain. Decoder sees loads/tractions only. Assume addressable, nondestructive, frozen-state microprobes.
added_rules.reason: Make observability testable; this is a synthetic probing assumption, not established clay instrumentation.

added_rules.name: Finite material code
added_rules.statement: Fixed slots encode origin, recipient, event ID, interval, predecessor mask, independent observations/reports, context, relationship samples, seven actions and all P x 6 symmetric strain-change components. Int16 quantization and CRC32 are explicit.
added_rules.reason: Preserve the four required distinctions at declared finite precision and capacity.

added_rules.name: No overwrite or silent repair
added_rules.statement: Writes refuse duplicate IDs, exhausted capacity, invalid ranges or schemas. Reads refuse ambiguous wells and checksum failures. No external log, denoising or error correction repairs data.
added_rules.reason: Expose finite memory failure instead of silently erasing or restoring it.

added_rules.name: Mechanical write stroke
added_rules.statement: A declared linear residual-strain stroke at fixed F changes stored energy and dissipates drag*delta_b^2/stroke_duration. Supplied work is stored change plus heat. The stroke work is a quartic: stationary points determine its peak, and the sum of positive coefficients supplies a conservative budget bound before any mutation.
added_rules.reason: Supply write work explicitly; an idealized event jump, not a calibrated actuator.

added_rules.name: Outcome separated from action
added_rules.statement: Observed recipient consequence and recipient report are independent signed fixture inputs, or explicitly missing. The action vector has no term in this outcome conversion. Average available observations/reports; positive/negative parts produce benefit/adversity evidence.
added_rules.reason: Remove refusal=harm and cooperation=benefit as outcome definitions.

added_rules.name: Recipient-directed retrieval
added_rules.statement: Decode records exclusively from fabric. Route history from origin j to recipient i into response entry (i,j). Context plus patch norms of the full retained tensor change form a Gaussian cue; integrate finite event durations with prior exposure.
added_rules.reason: Define indices, readout and relevance; no universal human response claim.

added_rules.name: Material utility
added_rules.statement: Replace action-signed utility with mean retrieved beneficial-minus-adverse consequence, retaining declared meaning/margin/scalar terms. Read-feedback control cuts only the returned evidence.
added_rules.reason: Prevent the source utility from recreating the old action-to-valence shortcut.

added_rules.name: Event windows and order
added_rules.statement: Three prescribed observation intervals include overlap. Capture current F at interval start, write full delta E at end, discard temporary start data. A predecessor exists when its recorded end is at or before this start; slot number is not causal order.
added_rules.reason: Define finite observation windows without pretending to infer causation from before/after change.

added_rules.name: Registered source preserved
added_rules.statement: Keep A_dot=gamma*(U-Ubaseline), J=kappa*A and C transport with normalized kernel. C is the registered signed scalar, distinct from u or joules. Choose smooth_off/calibrated, x direction in a 3D periodic cube.
added_rules.reason: Retain source equations while declaring the extended setting and input mapping.

added_rules.name: Joint integration and event budget
added_rules.statement: Heun integrates fields, material exposure, fabric and social states. Split intervals at every declared event boundary. Integrated force-work and separate write-work ledgers are compared to total kinetic+elastic+thermal energy.
added_rules.reason: Avoid archive-only or unaccounted coupling.

added_rules.name: Added-law status and inherited limits
added_rules.statement: All runs claim corpus validation false. v2 had a retained 96/192-point strain discrepancy. This revision uses 384 reference points and compares time, grid and 640 points; these are independent new results.
added_rules.reason: Do not erase historical failures or inherit validation.

added_rules.name: Finite testing perimeter
added_rules.statement: Roundtrip, participant swap, order/concurrency, tensor precision, archive poisoning, body-only reload, stress derivative, dissipation, writing budget, noise/failure, and joint feedback tests are declared before execution.
added_rules.reason: Test against independent invariants and counterexamples, not only a successful baseline.
